summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repo. Changes: rich/progress.py (new TimeElapsedColumn, Task.finished_time field, finished property now finished_time-based, capture/clear logic in update, advance, reset, and Task._reset); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with local imports and TYPE_CHECKING table import); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entries); tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast); tests/test_progress.py (test_time_elapsed_column, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns and its expected string regenerated by hand from a clock-read trace). Nothing was run, per instructions, so test_columns and the new tests are unverified; I checked the expected string by token diff against HEAD, which showed only the expected changes (elapsed cells, bar widths 33→25 and 23→16, speed values and padding). Nothing committed. docs/source/progress.rst was not updated.
